design_notes: Lines 334-336: 'the lowest economy fare (coach) that meets the business need (including arrival and departure times) via the most direct and expeditious route'. The American connection through Miami is $125 cheaper but takes 480 minutes against the Avianca nonstop's 330; both land the day before the meeting. On one reading the route words only qualify the lowest fare (book Miami); on the other the fare must be on the most direct and expeditious route (book the nonstop). Hold either.
